title: Resilience Analysis Through Automated Stage Identification and Quantitative Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.34527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduced an ML-based approach, designed to be domain- and threat-agnostic, for automated recognition of PARA (Plan/Prepare, Absorb, Recover, Adapt) resilience stages in system-performance time series, enabling subsequent quantitative resilience analysis across different systems. We investigate four ML models for resilience stage recognition: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). We then use the ML models' predictions to quantify system resilience by computing corresponding resilience metrics from system-performance data observed before, during, and after disruptive events. We evaluate the proposed approach using datasets from two distinct operational domain network systems and an airport transportation system, demonstrating its domain-agnostic applicability to resilience assessment. translated_title: 通过自动化阶段识别与定量评估的韧性分析
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的方法，该方法被设计为与领域和威胁无关，可自动识别系统性能时间序列中的PARA（规划/准备、吸收、恢复、适应）韧性阶段，从而支持对不同系统开展后续的定量韧性分析。我们研究了四种用于韧性阶段识别的机器学习模型：随机森林（RF）、支持向量机（SVM）、轻量梯度提升机以及极端梯度提升（XGBoost）。随后，我们利用这些机器学习模型的预测结果，通过从干扰事件发生前、发生期间和发生之后观测到的系统性能数据计算相应的韧性指标，来量化系统韧性。我们使用来自两个不同运营领域网络系统和一个机场交通系统的数据集对所提出的方法进行了评估，证明了该方法在韧性评估方面具有与领域无关的通用适用性。结果表明了（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种与领域和威胁无关的机器学习方法，自动识别系统性能时间序列中的PARA韧性阶段，并结合事件前、中、后的性能数据计算韧性指标以实现定量韧性评估，在多个不同领域的系统数据上验证了其通用性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a domain- and threat-agnostic ML approach that automatically identifies PARA resilience stages in system-performance time series and quantifies resilience using metrics computed from pre-, during-, and post-disruption data, demonstrating domain-agnostic applicability across multiple systems from different domains.
